title: docs(os-dev, AGENTS, pm-dispatch): local verification = changed packages typecheck/tests + families reading changed files; main merged after PR open only on conflict, main-red or queue removal
body:
Fixes #23378
Clause-②: no

Maintainer-directed charter change (Tier H: `AGENTS.md` + `.claude/**`), under the maintainer's 「同意」 (2026-10-14) on the director seat's proposal, verbatim and untranslated:

> 「dev 本地验证瘦身,CI 是证据。本地只跑改动包的 typecheck 和测试、以及读到改动文件的门禁族;全量门禁族交给 PR 的 CI check-runs,ACCEPT 读 check-runs(复审员已经这么做)。消融只在「改的是有测试钉住的行为」时做,配置、脚本、文档改动不做。」

Ruling A on #23390 (record 6160990111, maintainer 「23390 同意」) rides this PR as the director's comment on the card directs; #22998's lane-stop rule is unchanged. #23390 remains open. #22998 remains open. Text only: no `scripts/**`, no `.github/**`; `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, its data file, its self-test and CI's `select-gate-families` are untouched. `references/execution-duties.md`, `references/contract-review.md` and `references/cross-repo-coordination.md` are untouched (PR #23389's). The reading-only dev mode line is #23379's, not written here.

Two commits, so the quotes below map to commits: `869721b5c4` carries the card's four changes (`os-dev.md` only); `63496bd46c` carries ruling A's three lines (`AGENTS.md`, `os-dev.md`, the dispatch template).

## The card's rule sentences — before and after (`.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, commit `869721b5c4`)

**(1) Local evidence.** Before (L138, L141, L147–148):

> - ③ 派发词点名的门禁族,加上你看得出被牵连的。
> - ④ 派发词的门禁清单是线索不是规格,当天取的也会漏族;点名的跑绿后按实际改动重推。
> - 补跑它新增而你的 diff 触及的,报告里点名新增项;另一半归 PM,在你报告后读真实结论。
> - ⛔ 不据此跳过点名族:它们仍是你欠的便宜一半;你不再欠的是报告前等 CI。

After (L138, L140, L146):

> - ③ 读到改动文件的门禁族 = `--commands` 派生清单(按 diff 收窄);派发词清单与全农场归 CI。
> - ④ 报告 `gates`:CI 跑的每族引 PR check-runs(名+结论),⛔ 不本地重跑;`--ran` 只对账本地子集。
> - 派生点名却不在 PR check-runs 的族(选择器跳过或仅 push/schedule):本地读数即证据,报告标明。

L142 (the `--ran` line) keeps its shape and now says the unrun families it names are the local ones: 「跑完把已跑清单交给 `--ran FILE` 对账,未跑的本地族它会点名」 (FILE spelled out here for the body sanitizer; the file has the usual angle-bracket placeholder). The derivation command itself (L141) stays; the dispatch word's lead list is CI's.

The report template (L367–368) gains the field the card names, beside the reshaped `tests`:

> "tests": "commands run + pass/fail evidence (real output excerpts); ablation only where a tested behaviour changed: rebuild + on-disk mutation proof",
> "gates": "local subset: each command + exit code captured before any pipe + --ran reconciliation; every family CI runs: the PR's check-runs (name + conclusion) cited, not re-run locally",

**(2) Ablation.** Before: no rule stated when an ablation is owed; the mechanics (L246–265) applied whenever one was run. After (new L241, ahead of the mechanics, which stay as they are):

> - 消融一行为一次,仅当 diff 改了测试钉住的行为;配置、脚本、workflow、文档 ⛔ 不消融。

**(3) The local-only family list.** Before: none. After (L147–149):

> - 本地独有族(CI 只跑其 `--self-test`,不跑扫描):`check:dev-prereqs`、`check:skill-frame-freshness`。
> - 二者判本机状态(`packages/spec/dist` 过期否、检出对 origin/main 新鲜否),CI 新检出无可判。
> - 派生不点名二者;触 `packages/spec` 构建或四轴框架文件时本地跑,读数只进报告,留在本地。

How the list was measured (tree `63496bd46c`): the root `package.json` declares 177 `check:*` aliases. Every workflow under `.github/workflows/` was read with its comment lines dropped and only command lines (`node`/`pnpm`/`bash`/`run_self_test`) counted; a one-line `a --self-test && a` chain counts as a production run. 160 aliases run in CI by alias, 15 run in CI under the `node` spelling (production and self-test), and exactly 2 have a CI step for their `--self-test` half and none for their scan: `check:dev-prereqs` (lint.yml step "Self-test the dev-prereqs gate (self-test half only, never the scan)"; the scan judges this machine's `packages/spec/dist` for `pnpm dev`, and the script's own header says the scan is "a local preflight no pull request schedules") and `check:skill-frame-freshness` (lint.yml step "Self-test the skill-frame freshness gate (self-test half only, never the scan)"; the scan asks whether THIS working tree's frame is current with `origin/main`, and a fresh CI checkout "cannot be stale by construction" per the script's header). The ledger `SELF_TEST_ALIASES_OUTSIDE_CI` in `scripts/check-self-test-wired.mjs` is empty, consistent with this: both scans ship a self-test CI does run. The derivation (`dispatch-gates.mjs`) also reports 0 unreachable families and names the reverse direction separately (1 CI-measured-only family that reads the event payload; `check-required-contexts --verify-required-set`, which takes a value from the workflow) — those are CI's, never local.

**(4) The seat's ACCEPT** reads the PR's check-runs (the reviewer's R5 shape). That rule lives on the seat side (`references/execution-duties.md` / `review-checklist.md`), which PR #23389 edits in flight and this card forbids touching; the dev-side half of it is L140 above (the report cites check-runs, not a local sweep). Noted in Acceptance notes for the seat.

## Ruling A — the three lines, before and after (commit `63496bd46c`)

Binding text (record 6160990111): "before a PR is opened, merge `main` once and run the full suite once (AGENTS.md §10 as written). After the PR is open, merge `main` only when (a) GitHub reports a conflict, (b) the PR's CI is red because of `main`, or (c) the merge queue removes the PR. After such a merge, run §10's scoped re-checks only. Dogfood runs once, on the final head."

**`AGENTS.md` §10 (L584–585).** The sentence before it — "**Before opening a PR, pull `main`, refresh build state (§9), and run the full suite once.**" — stays as written. Before:

> state (§9), and run the full suite once.** For the *subsequent* pre-merge merges of
> `main` — the ones you do only because `main` moved again while CI ran — scope it:

After:

> state (§9), and run the full suite once.** After the PR is open, merge `main` only on a GitHub-reported
> conflict, a `main`-caused CI red or a queue removal, then only the scoped re-checks; dogfood once, on the final head:

The colon still introduces §10's own scoped re-check bullets, unchanged. Same two lines, so no AGENTS.md line is added or deleted (1116/1116).

**`.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (new L275, in Definition of done, after the Draft-PR line).** Before: no line. After:

> - PR 开出后合 main 只因冲突、main 致 CI 红、出队,后只跑 §10 复检;dogfood 只在终 head 跑一次。

**`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` L220 (the dispatch template's four-sentence overlap warning; the merge-`main` sentence is the one that moves).** Before:

> - 四句:合 main 重跑测试矩阵、读对方 diff 重划边界、只补它没覆盖的、被完全覆盖就停下。

After:

> - 四句:合 main 只因冲突/main 致红/出队,再 §10 复检、按其 diff 划界、补缺口、全覆盖即停。

No other line of that file moves (241/241). The three spellings differ by file language and the 120-byte line cap; each carries the same three triggers and the scoped re-check. The dogfood clause is in the AGENTS.md sentence and the os-dev.md line; the runbook's template line has no room for it under the cap and the overlap warning is not where dogfood is decided — flagged in Acceptance notes for the seat to rule on.

## Line budget — every added line paid in the same file

| file | before | after | ceiling | headroom |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` | 402 | 400 | 402 | 2 |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` | 241 | 241 | 241 | 0 |
| `AGENTS.md` | 1116 | 1116 | 1116 | 0 |

`os-dev.md` additions: 5 (two local-only list lines beyond the rewritten L148, the ablation rule, the ruling-A line, the `gates` JSON line). Deletions: 7, each named with why:

- old L140 「`.claude/agents/**` ⇒ `check:agent-model-declared`;任何编辑 ⇒ `check:nul-bytes`」 — restates what the derivation already places for every card (`check:agent-model-declared` is matched by path for `.claude/agents/**`; `check:nul-bytes` declares a whole-tree population and is named on every card). The sibling L139 stays: `check:error-code-casing` is an artifact-roster family the derivation cannot place.
- old L158–163 (six lines: 「前台上限之内跑得完就可以跑…」, 「默认交付形态是已证明的收窄…」, the three-evidence protocol ①②③ and its verdict line) — the local-eslint narrowing procedure. Superseded by change (1): `pnpm lint` is a declared-wide family (CI runs it over the whole root; the derivation lists it among the 11 wide-population families and never in a card's runnable total), so its evidence is the PR's `Lint · eslint` check-run and a "proven local narrowing" is exactly the local sweep the ruling removes. L157 (「仓级扫描…是 CI 拥有的运行,永不是你欠的」) stays and now states the whole rule. No re-wrap was used as currency.

The ceilings in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` are not lowered (this card forbids `scripts/**`); the 2-line headroom on `os-dev.md` is reported for the next leg.

## Changed line ranges, for #23379 (merges by semantics)

- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (new numbering): L138; L140; L142; L146–149; a 6-line deletion between L157 and L158 (old L158–163); L241 (inserted); L275 (inserted); L367–368 (JSON `tests` reshaped, `gates` inserted).
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md`: L220 only.
- `AGENTS.md`: L584–585 only.

## Gates — exit codes captured before any pipe (`cmd > log 2>&1; EXIT=$?`)

Acceptance gates on head `63496bd46c`: `pnpm -s check:pm-skill-ratchet` 0 (os-dev.md 400/402, dispatch-runbook.md 241/241, AGENTS.md 1116/1116; every line within 120 bytes or structurally exempt) · `pnpm -s check:pm-skill-id-lint` 0 (87 files clean) · `pnpm check:agent-model-declared` 0 · `pnpm check:nul-bytes` 0 · `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose` 0. No model name in any file, title, body or commit trailer (`pnpm check:commit-card-trailers` 0).

Local subset = `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the real diff at `63496bd46c`: 23 commands (15 matched by path, 8 declared whole-tree). Every one was run; exits: all 0 except `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions`, which first answered its declared PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3, `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` unbuilt — "Nothing was measured") and, after `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` under the verify lock, exit 0 on the rerun (`check-doc-formula-expressions`: self-test and scan both pass). `--ran` reconciliation: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran ran-coded.txt --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` exit 0, record in the `command :: exit N` form it asks for — 23 derived, 23 run, 0 UNRUN, 0 NOT-MEASURED (one extra recorded run outside the derivation, `check:pm-settings-deny-roster`). Also run because the derivation flagged its roster as living under `.claude/`: `pnpm check:pm-settings-deny-roster` 0.

Every family CI runs on this PR is read from the PR's check-runs, not re-run here — which is the rule this PR writes. No package is touched, so there is no ① build closure and no ② package typecheck/test. No tested behaviour changes (text only), so no ablation — the rule this PR writes.

`skip-changeset` applies: nothing under `.claude/**` or `AGENTS.md` ships in any package's `files[]`.

## Acceptance notes

- Change (4) (the seat's ACCEPT reads check-runs) has its home in the seat-side references that PR #23389 edits in flight and this card forbids touching; the dev side of it is written here (L140). Carrier: the `domain:skills` seat on the #23389 landing, or #23379's leg.
- The runbook's four-sentence template carries the three triggers and the scoped re-check but not the dogfood clause (120-byte cap on a line this card may not split; the PM's own paraphrase for that line omits it). If the seat wants it there, it costs one line paid in that file.
- AGENTS.md §10 keeps "run the full suite once" before the PR opens (ruling A: "as written"), while `os-dev.md` 本地验证范围 defines what the dev's local suite is. Boundary, not a finding: the dev's "suite" was already the local subset before this PR.
- The derivation's output on this diff lists 15 families as "pending-changeset" (derived against `.changeset/` paths that do not exist for a `skip-changeset` PR) and 51 artifact-roster families as silent-by-construction; neither block is a clearance and neither is this card's. Observation only.
- `check:dev-prereqs` and `check:skill-frame-freshness` were not run here: this diff touches neither the `packages/spec` build nor the four-axis frame file, which is the trigger the new L149 states.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:三个文件、文字改动。① `os-dev.md`:dev 本地只跑改动包的 typecheck/测试和「读到改动文件」的门禁族(派生清单),全农场交给 PR 的 CI check-runs,报告新增 `gates` 字段引 check-runs;消融只在改了有测试钉住的行为时做;列出 CI 不跑扫描半的两个族(`check:dev-prereqs`、`check:skill-frame-freshness`)及原因。② 裁决 A(#23390):PR 开出后只在 GitHub 报冲突、main 致 CI 红或被队列移出时合 main,之后只做 §10 定向复检;dogfood 只在最终 head 跑一次 —— 同一句写进 `AGENTS.md` §10、`os-dev.md`、派发模板。

**为什么改**:本轮召唤实测每个 dev 本地跑 39–87 条门禁命令、再由 CI 重跑同一批;消融被要求到配置与脚本改动上。您的裁决:本地瘦身,CI 是证据。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:风险是 dev 本地少跑一轮、缺陷晚到 PR 的 CI 才红;代价由 CI 承担(它本来就跑全量)。三个文件都在行数棘轮上限,新增行以同文件删除支付(删的是派生已覆盖的示例行与被本裁决取代的本地 eslint 收窄流程)。回滚 = revert 本 PR 的两个 commit,无代码、无发布面。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:Tier H,草稿 PR 等您合并;若希望派发模板那一句也带 dogfood 子句,席位补一行(需在该文件内删一行支付)。
